name: senpi-strategy-author
description: Build or edit the user's OWN Senpi trading strategy — interactively, ONE decision at a time. The DEFAULT for every strategy ask: a thesis or an X take, "build a strategy", "I have a trading idea", "what should I trade?" (as a strategy ask, not a market read), "recommend a strategy" (naming stocks or coins keeps it one: "a basket like Apple, Microsoft and Nvidia" gets templates from discover, never stock research), "set me up", and mandates ("trade for me", "you decide", "be aggressive": one or two questions make it a thesis, then build). Also ANY strategy that needs DSL (stop-loss, trailing stop, profit-lock ladder): raw MCP strategy_create* / create_position calls can't carry a DSL and must never stand up a named or protected strategy; a strategy built here does. Finds the closest template FIRST (senpi-strategy-discover) as the BASE the user forks and makes theirs (a lever shifted, a rule of their own) before it goes live; scratch when nothing fits. No paper-trading mode: test with `senpi validate` and a $10-floor live run, never a scanner re-run on a timer. Never asks for a budget to build (asked once, at deploy); exits default to letting winners run, stated in price at leverage; the user names what you build. NOT for installing (senpi-strategy-ops).
